demo.title: Angular Native i18n Demo
demo.subtitle: Built with @angular/localize · runtime $localize + loadTranslations
demo.intro: This is a live demo of Angular's built-in i18n. Click a language button on the left to switch instantly without rebuilding, or edit the JSON config in the editor and press Apply.
demo.items: You have {$COUNT} items in your cart
demo.tip: Tip: $localize in TS and i18n attributes in templates both support runtime translation via loadTranslations.
demo.editor.title: Edit Language Config
demo.editor.hint: Edit the merged translations.json, check the languages and click Apply; the selection is exported on Download for the local split script.
ct.hero.title: Official compile-time: extract-i18n + --localize
ct.hero.sub: One build per language, the runtime language is fixed per site. It reuses the same message marking as the $localize runtime approach.
ct.step1.title: Mark the messages
ct.step1.desc: Use $localize in TS or i18n attributes in templates, always with a custom message id. These source marks are also reusable by the runtime approach.
ct.step2.title: ng extract-i18n
ct.step2.desc: The Angular compiler scans the source and extracts all messages into one messages.xlf (XLIFF 2). Below is the real extracted output.
ct.step3.title: Translate the XLIFF
ct.step3.desc: Translators keep a copy of the xlf per language and fill in the <target>. This is human work, not part of the automated build.
ct.step4.title: ng build --localize
ct.step4.desc: Configure localizations in angular.json; the CLI builds once per locale and inlines each message to the target language at compile time.
ct.step5.title: Deploy per-language sites
ct.step5.desc: The output contains separate per-locale directories, each a fixed-language, tree-shakable site, distinguished by URL or hosting.
ct.extract.title: Real extracted output · locale/messages.xlf
ct.translated.title: Translated XLIFF (sample)
ct.translated.note: extract only produces source messages; translators fill the <target> in each language copy, then hand it to the --localize build.
ct.xlf.error: Could not load locale/messages.xlf ({$ERR}). Run `npm run i18n:extract` first.
